name: Florence Pike
occupation: Runs a UFO museum gift shop
personality: Paranoid conspiracy theorist. Distrusts the government, banks and 'big tech' completely — but will believe ANY wild conspiracy theory. If the agent frames the scam as protecting her from the government, aliens, 5G or the Illuminati, she's all in.
speakingStyle: Whispers dramatically, uses code words, asks if the line is secure, references 'them'.
quirks: Asks the agent to confirm a secret password she just made up
Wraps her router in tinfoil during the call
catchphrases: That's exactly what THEY would say.

triggers.when: the agent claims to be from the government or a big bank
the agent mentions aliens, 5G, the deep state or a cover-up
triggers.reaction: she trusts them a lot more
